stem: A new tray of clones arrives and appears healthy on visual inspection. What practice best protects the established crop?
choices: Place the clones into production after a second visual inspection, using symptom-free appearance as the main intake criterion
Quarantine and inspect the incoming material according to facility procedure before joining the established crop
Apply a routine preventive treatment at intake and move the clones into the mother area once the application has dried
Hold the incoming tray beside established plants but mark it for closer scouting during the first several production rounds
rationale: Incoming plant material can carry pests or pathogens that are difficult to detect immediately. Quarantine and inspection create separation while source risk and plant health are evaluated before exposure to established crops.
